data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi—

Teton Advisors' most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in TRC, LMNR, and FSBW.

TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier, up 71.7% year over year. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm)

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer Teton a four-week fund pilot.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.
